text:
incident-bot: ALERT: [P1] Elevated 5xx rate (>=8%) on /v1/embeddings/generate — oxford-payments-prod (dedicated, eu-west-1). Pager triggered for oncall + #incidents. Incident ID INC-20260715-01

Alex (oncall): Ack — I'm on it. Starting live triage: grabbing service logs, tailing nginx + runtime, checking routing table. Will attempt immediate routing-fallback if errors persist.

Ben - SRE: Seen the spike. Metrics show KV cache miss surge + GRPC backpressure on serving nodes 12-14 beginning ~02:09 UTC. Suspect model shard rebalance coincident with a quantized model rollout. I'm preparing the fallback route: `model: embeddings-lite-v1` and will update routing within 2 min.

Carla (Customer Success): Noted. Affected enterprise customers (priority outbound):
- Oxford Payments (acct: OXF-001) — primary: j.sandoval@oxfordpay.com, backup: ops@oxfordpay.com, phone: +44 207 555 0123
- Wren Financial (acct: WRE-113) — primary: t.lam@wrenfin.com (Slack), backup: cs@wrenfin.com
- Lattice Health (acct: LTH-900) — primary: tara@latticehealth.org, backup: platform@latticehealth.org
Will prepare tailored impact blurbs once we have ETA.

Dave (Eng): Quick note from runtime traces: large KV eviction spike due to memory pressure after quantization layer applied. Some nodes dropped active KV segments, causing cold-cache tokenization/latency and request queueing. Patch idea: revert quantization for affected shard or widen cache allocation. I can prepare rollback PR but need SRE to toggle routing.

Ben - SRE: Routing fallback in place: `route: eu-west-dedicated -> embeddings-lite-v1` applied at 02:16 UTC. Observability: 5xx rate dropping but p95 still elevated. Continuing rollback plan for quantized shard.

Alex (oncall): Good. Carla — can you draft status page + customer email? Emily — want a short internal comm template for Exec/AE outreach. Frank — prep support threads.

Emily (PM): Suggested status page snippet (short):
```
Title: Degraded performance for embeddings generation — eu-west-1
Impact: Some dedicated customers may experience increased errors or latency generating embeddings. We are actively mitigating; fallback routing enabled.
What we're doing: Rolling back recent quantized shard change and increasing KV cache allocation.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when the issue is resolved.
```
Use that as the public-facing text.

Carla (Customer Success): Draft outbound for Oxford Payments (tailored):
```
Subject: Incident: Temporary degradation of embeddings for Oxford Payments — we are on it
Hi Jorge —
We detected elevated errors affecting your embeddings generation on oxford-payments-prod. We have enabled a fallback route and are rolling back a recent model optimization that caused cache churn. You may observe some elevated latency for ~15-45 minutes.
What we’re doing: fallback routing + rollback of the quantization shard; monitoring closely.
ETA: Initial mitigation complete, full stability expected within 30–60 minutes.
If you need immediate assistance, call +44 207 555 0123 or reply to this thread. Apologies for the disruption — Carla, Customer Success (Redwood)
```
I'll queue this out to Jorge and ops@oxfordpay.com after Alex confirms mitigation.

Frank (Support): I'll open a high-priority ticket for each affected account and attach the tailored blurb. I'll also create a shared thread with Oxford's SRE contact so they have a direct line.

Ben - SRE: Executed rollback of quantized shard on nodes 12-14 at 02:28 UTC; increased KV cache by 25% on eu-west-1 serving pool. Post-change metrics: 5xx rate down to ~0.9% at 02:31 UTC; tail latency p95 trending toward normal.

Alex (oncall): Monitoring — thanks Ben. Please hold on customer emails until we confirm 30m stability window. Carla/Frank stand by for outbound at confirmation.

Dave (Eng): I'll run the postmortem instrumentation now to capture KV eviction traces and make the rollback permanent patch in the staging branch. Need to sync with Ben for node drain schedule.

Ben - SRE: Agreed. I'll run a controlled drain + compute a canary pass before final promotion.

Alex (oncall): Update for internal comms / AE/Execs (short):
- Impacted: select dedicated customers in eu-west-1 (not all hosted API).
- Root cause: KV cache churn after quantized shard rollout.
- Mitigation: routing fallback + rollback + cache allocation increase.
- Current status: error rate near baseline; monitoring for 30m stable.
Assigning Ben for post-mortem actions and Dave for permanent fix.

Frank (Support): Sending initial tickets and creating the Oxford shared thread now. Will CC Carla.

Carla (Customer Success): Oxford outbound sent at 02:34 UTC (subject and body as above) to j.sandoval@oxfordpay.com and ops@oxfordpay.com. Wren Financial and Lattice Health queued pending stability check.

Ben - SRE: Marking mitigation step complete. Will move to observability watch and then to post-incident review.

Alex (oncall): Resolution: error rate stable <1% at 02:40 UTC. We'll keep this thread open until 03:10 UTC to confirm stability, then update status page to resolved and send final follow-up to customers with root cause summary and mitigations. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Ben - SRE: Noted — kicking off post-incident ticket: PI-INC-20260715-01 (action items: permanent cache allocation change, rollback gating for quantization rollouts, improve canary checks).

Dave (Eng): I'll attach the instrumentation logs and propose the PR for the permanent fix.

Carla (Customer Success): Final follow-up draft for customers (to send after 30m stable):
```
Hi Jorge —
Follow-up: the issue affecting embeddings generation has been mitigated. Root cause: quantized shard rollout caused unexpected KV cache evictions on a subset of eu-west-1 serving nodes, leading to higher error rates. What we did: enabled fallback routing, rolled back the quantized shard, and increased cache allocation.
Customers may see a small uptick in latency for the next hour as caches warm. We are performing a post-incident review and will share a technical summary within 48 hours.
Apologies again for the disruption — Carla, Redwood Customer Success
```

Frank (Support): I'll send the final follow-ups when Alex gives the green light.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260715-01 mitigation steps logged. Will auto-close if thread inactive for 24 hours.
